stories.headline: AI credit stress spreads across borrowers as CoreWeave bond yields approach 18%
stories.body: For corporate bond investors, Reuters reported five-year CDS spreads of 1,314 basis points for CoreWeave, 501 for SoftBank Group and 356 for Oracle. CoreWeave, Oracle, Alphabet and SpaceX reached record CDS levels over the previous two trading sessions. Nvidia-backed CoreWeave’s 2031 bond yield approached 18%, its 2030 bonds reached record lows, and SoftBank shares fell 14%. Reuters cited a market-implied five-year default probability of 68% for CoreWeave. Individual quote times and the substantive revision time were unavailable. These recovered historical observations are not live prices, issuance yields or confirmed defaults.
stories.analysis: Credit protection prices and bond yields indicate financing concerns beyond equity valuations. A market-implied probability depends on pricing and modelling assumptions; it does not establish that a default will occur.
stories.watch_next: Refinancing access, free cash flow, collateral values and credit spreads.

stories.headline: US October new-home sales rise 14.2% as builders cut prices
stories.body: Reuters reported October new single-family home sales rising 14.2% month on month to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 701,000 units. Median new-home prices fell 3.2% year on year to US$391,300, while the prior week’s average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 7.28%. The sales rate is annualised, rather than the number of houses actually sold during October; the mortgage rate refers to a different weekly period. Builders’ discounts supported transactions. No isolated market reaction was established. This is a recovered 25 November report, with exact original publication minutes and development time unestablished independently.
stories.analysis: Discount-supported sales growth does not by itself establish a broad housing recovery. Sales volumes, selling prices and mortgage borrowing costs measure different conditions.
stories.watch_next: Housing inventory, construction permits and mortgage rates.
